messages.subject: BART trialxtrial fMRI model regressors
parts:
Hi guys,

Thank you again for this fantastic package!

I'm wondering if trial x trial regressors for fMRI are possible for the BART. When I tried, I got an error message that they are not available for the bart_par4 model, but wanted to check in case that has changed. 

Thank you again!

Zoe

messages.author: 47d1400f432367d7
messages.subject: Re: BART trialxtrial fMRI model regressors
parts:
Hi Zoe,

Thanks for using it! 

Unfortunately we do not yet have the regressor option available for the BART. That said, to extract them would require modifying the Stan codes (akin to what is done with the go/no-go models: https://github.com/CCS-Lab/hBayesDM/blob/develop/commons/stan_files/gng_m1.stan). 

Best,
Nate
